purpose: Authoritative SATCOM ordering for the operator's agent stack. Roles are separated so a coding client is not misrepresented as a model provider.

primary.role: Primary agent and cloud intelligence lane
primary.requiredConnection: Authenticated Grok Bot plus a healthy SATCOM MCP handshake

primary.role: Primary implementation workspace and MCP client

fallback.role: Host-local fallback agent and planning lane
fallback.activationRule: Use only after the local WebUI or crew bridge passes a health check.

fallback.role: Host-local fallback model runtime for Hermes
fallback.activationRule: Use only after the Ollama model endpoint responds and the requested model is present.

support.role: Authenticated cloud connection used by Grok Bot
Local stdio MCP shared by Cursor and discovered by Grok Bot
Optional provider MCP; separate from SATCOM routing
support.activationRule: Use only after its OAuth handshake succeeds. A Stripe OAuth failure must not mark Grok Bot or the SATCOM receptionist MCP offline.

support.role: Optional scoped credential broker; never a prerequisite for read-only SATCOM tools

routingRules: Start new implementation and operator-agent work with Grok Bot and Cursor.
Do not claim Hermes or Ollama is available until the operator host passes its local health checks.
A working xAI inference API does not prove that an xAI Voice agent or phone route is published.
MCP tools may inspect, prepare, and hand off. External contact, live sends, billing, DNS, deployment, and destructive operations retain their separate approval gates.
Never expose provider credentials in SATCOM HTML, JSON status files, logs, prompts, or repository history.

compatibility.rule: Agent routing changes must not modify the existing postcard QR asset, target URL, proofing paths, or subscribe.thevillager.today root redirect.
